tha-ap125:1.1: Pāyāsadāyaka.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ dvattiṃsavaralakkhaṇaṃ / pavanā abhinikkhantaṃ bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhataṃ. // //
tha-ap125:2.1: Sahatthā kaṃsapātiyā vaḍḍhetvā pāyāsaṃ ahaṃ / āhutiyiṭṭhukāmo so agamāsiṃ balim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap125:3.1: Bhagavā tamhi samaye lokajeṭṭho narāsabho / caṅkamaṃ susamārūḷho ambare anilāyane. // //
tha-ap125:4.1: Tañ ca acchariyaṃ disvā abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ / ṭhapayitvā kaṃsapātiṃ Vipassiṃ abhivādayiṃ. // //
tha-ap125:5.1: Tuvaṃ devo 'si sabbaññū sadevasahamānuse / anukampaṃ upādāya patigaṇha mahāmune. // //
tha-ap125:6.1: Paṭiggahesi bhagavā sabbaññū lokanāyako / mama saṅkappam aññāya satthā loke mahāmuni. // //
tha-ap125:7.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pāyāsassa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap125:8.1: Ekatālis' ito kappe Buddho nāmā 'si khattiyo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahābalo. // //
tha-ap125:9.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanaṃ
tha-ap125:10.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pāyāsadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
